title: OrganizerBillingPlanDocument
description: One organizer's choice of Catch plan (#1126): ticketing (commission on sales, the default) or tools-only (a flat fee per billing cycle and no commission, never both in one cycle). Tools-only is bought only on the web: buying creates a Razorpay payment link on Catch's own account for one tools-only fee, which prepays the first tools-only cycle; the payment_link.paid webhook marks the plan active after reading the link back. The plan applies from the next billing cycle, never mid-cycle. Cancelling ends tools-only when the current cycle closes, and never before the prepaid cycle. Server-only; owners act through manageOrganizerBillingPlan and staff read it through adminManageOrganizerBills.
x-owner: Functions organizer billing (manageOrganizerBillingPlan, Razorpay payment link webhook, daily cycle generation)

status.description: pendingPayment: tools-only bought and its payment link not yet paid. active: paid; tools-only applies from startsAtMillis (null: from the first billing cycle) until endsAtMillis (null: until cancelled). ended: back on ticketing.

startsAtMillis.description: The first billing cycle start tools-only applies to; null until the organizer's first cycle is known.

endsAtMillis.description: Cycles starting at or after this are ticketing again.

amountMinor.description: What the link asks for: the tools-only fee plus GST while registered.

prepaidBillId.description: The cycle bill the purchase paid for, once that cycle is billed.
